baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same following verb at 47:3:5 and 47:3:10 attaches two matched groups to opposite objects.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following contributes directed movement behind a lead, while falsehood lacks truth and stability and truth remains fixed against it. The verse therefore sets out two rival trajectories whose destinations are already implicit in what each group trails.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and going after supply literal directed motion; the paired occurrences make falsehood and truth rival leads rather than static labels.
Departure from truth and stability supplies an object that cannot hold; it makes one trajectory structurally self-losing.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies a firm object; it gives the opposed trajectory something that can bear continued following.

changed_reading.before: The verse sorts people by two opposed beliefs.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts two groups in motion behind rival leads, one unstable and one reality-bearing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Belief, truth, and the phrase 'from their Lord' are linked on the second side of the focus contrast.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief can be settled trust, and the Lord-root can supply ownership, tending, completion, and, through its split mapping, growth. Following truth from this source can therefore be read as entrusting oneself to a formative process, not only assenting to a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted repose supply the literal affective state; they recast belief as entrustment within the truthward path.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply formative care; they make the truth's source an active cultivator of the follower.
Feeding and growth supply organic development from the split root mapping; they keep maturation as a live, form-distant dimension of lordly formation.
Establishing and making truth manifest supply an active disclosure; the follower is formed by truth being brought to completion and visibility.

changed_reading.before: Believers accept a true statement supplied by their Lord.
changed_reading.after: Believers trustfully enter a Lord-originated process that establishes, repairs, and grows them in truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus pairs following with falsehood and with truth, whose branch ranges include claims, rights, and attached consequences.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following can carry pursuit by a claimant and a liability that catches up with a person; truth can be a binding or owned right, while falsehood can void what existed. Choosing what to follow thus also chooses which claim and consequence become attached.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit by one demanding a right supplies a claimant at one's heels; it turns following into entry under a demand.
An attached liability supplies the consequence that follows an act; it makes each alignment carry its own account.
A fixed obligation or entitlement supplies normative weight; truth is something due and binding, not only descriptively correct.
Making something void or removing it supplies operative cancellation; falsehood can erase efficacy rather than merely state an error.

changed_reading.before: Following names imitation of a true or false teaching.
changed_reading.after: Following accepts a claimant and an attached liability: truth binds as a right, while falsehood can cancel what the follower produces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing construction joins striking or casting with people's likenesses after the paired alignments.
baseline_models.mechanism: The striking root can both display an analogy and cast a type or disposition; the likeness root can denote resemblance, a represented image, and a lesson. The close may therefore render the two alignments as publicly legible and repeatable human patterns, not merely append a verbal illustration.

activation_trace.role: Portraying and making an analogy visible supply exposition; the divine act brings the preceding contrast before an audience.
A cast kind or form supplies reproducible patterning; it lets the exposition function as a human type that can recur.
Resemblance and counterpart supply comparison; the two groups become analogues by which other people can locate themselves.
A represented image supplies visible form; it supports reading the close as making otherwise latent orientations inspectable.

changed_reading.before: God explains the two groups by giving people parables.
changed_reading.after: God casts the groups' alignments into visible, comparable human patterns that can instruct and recur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate flanks connect each alignment to practical output: one group's works are made lost, while the other group's wrongs are covered and their condition repaired. The focus contrast therefore operates through the coherence or failure of deeds and inner condition.

activation_trace.role: Unbroken succession supplies a continuing sequence; it lets allegiance propagate into subsequent work rather than end at assent.
Loss of a thing supplies disappearance from effective reach; it gives the falseward trajectory a failed output.
Purposive action supplies the concrete output being lost; it carries the focus alignment into practice.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies both sound deeds and repair; the paired occurrences make truthward alignment productive and reparative.
A sound, eased condition supplies the repaired human state; it extends efficacy from deeds into inward composure.

structural_cues: 47:1 and 47:2 flank the focus with matched group clauses and opposite treatments of deeds; 47:2 also repeats the focus wording 'truth from their Lord' immediately before repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel group-and-result clauses; I infer that the object followed governs the coherence and efficacy of ensuing work. A live alternative is that the results are external divine judgments rather than an immanent causal outflow.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts two intellectual allegiances.
changed_reading.after: The focus contrasts orientations that propagate into whether action holds, is lost, or becomes reparative.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, stabilized feet, and increased guidance turn following truth into assisted forward motion, while stumbling gives the opposed path a bodily failure mode. The path is recursive: taking guidance becomes the condition for receiving more of it.

activation_trace.role: Catching up with a predecessor supplies pathwise progress; it makes the focus's following measurable as advance or failure to advance.
Gentle direction to a road supplies active route guidance; it assists the truthward follower after the initial alignment.
Strengthening something into stability supplies resistance to displacement; it keeps the guided trajectory from slipping.
The foot that treads supplies the bodily contact point of a path; its stabilization embodies continued following.
Stumbling and falling without recovery supply the inverse gait; they materialize the instability of following falsehood.
Direction to the road appears both as prior response and added gift; the paired occurrence supplies a feedback loop of guidance.
Increase and growth supply positive feedback; truthward motion enlarges the very guidance by which it moves.

structural_cues: The sequence 47:5-8 moves through future guidance, repair, support, fixed feet, and then the opposed group's stumble; 47:17 explicitly makes prior guidance precede added guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a motion-and-stability sequence plus explicit increase; I infer that following is a feedback trajectory in which response recruits further aid. A live alternative is that each benefit is a separate reward with no path mechanism between them.

changed_reading.before: Following truth means choosing the correct lead once.
changed_reading.after: Following truth begins an assisted gait that stabilizes and amplifies itself, while falseward motion culminates in unrecovered stumbling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel, looking, and the visible remainder of prior peoples turn the divine examples into historical readouts. The likeness is not confined to speech: repeated trajectories leave outcomes that later people can inspect and compare with themselves.

activation_trace.role: Making an example visible supplies the focus's expository act; context relocates that visibility into traversable history.
Moving and coursing through land supply embodied investigation; people must enter the field where the example can be read.
Directing sight or insight to apprehend a thing supplies deliberate observation; it converts inherited report into inspected evidence.
The last part and outcome supply a trajectory's terminal readout; it is what historical looking is asked to recover.
Root-and-branch destruction supplies a materially legible result; it makes the analogy persist as historical trace.
A lesson-sign supplies the explicit status of the analogous outcome; it links the focus's likenesses to evidence meant for inference.

structural_cues: Branchless ك ي ف at 47:10:6 asks how the prior outcome occurred, placing mechanism rather than mere recollection under inspection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, directed looking, outcome, ruin, and an explicit likeness; I infer that God 'strikes examples' partly by letting orientations generate inspectable historical traces. A live alternative is that 47:10 only supplies a separate warning by similar punishment.

changed_reading.before: God verbally illustrates the two orientations for an audience.
changed_reading.after: God makes their trajectories historically observable, so ruined outcomes become field evidence and recurring likenesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord-source expands into protective governance, while the opposed alignment later appears as concealed, partial obedience to people hostile to revelation. Following truth or falsehood is thus a social-political placement under rival relations of care, command, and coalition.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and governance supply the truth's authoritative source; they make alignment a relation of rule and care.
Protective love, support, and alliance supply relational backing; the paired presence and absence of a patron distinguish the two groups' infrastructures.
Aversion opposed to satisfaction supplies the coalition partner's orientation; obedience links the follower to hostility toward revelation.
Compliance and obedience supply enacted allegiance; they translate following into answering another party's command.
A partition or portion supplies limited scope; it shows that falseward allegiance may operate through selective compromise rather than total declaration.
Concealment in the interior supplies secrecy; it makes coalition-following latent until disclosed.

structural_cues: 47:11 repeats the focus's believer/unbeliever pairing through presence or absence of a patron, while 47:26 couches partial obedience in private speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patronage and a secret promise of partial obedience; I infer that following names placement inside an allegiance network. A live alternative is that patronage is only a later reward and the promise only an isolated act of hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: The groups privately assent to opposite propositions.
changed_reading.after: The groups inhabit rival allegiance structures: one under lordly protection, the other capable of concealed, piecemeal compliance with hostile partners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposed trajectories become two material economies of desire: sustained flow and provision on one side, short-loop enjoyment, eating, distraction, and a terminal dwelling on the other. What is followed shapes both appetite and the habitat in which appetite ends.

activation_trace.role: Idleness, uselessness, and diversion from beneficial work supply a misdirected mode of life; context gives it an appetite-driven material form.
Continuous flowing supplies sustained provision; it contrasts a renewable truthward habitat with immediate consumption.
A watercourse cutting through land supplies an organized channel of life; it gives the truthward outcome durable material structure.
A benefit enjoyed for pleasure supplies immediate gratification; it drives the opposed trajectory's short horizon.
Literal ingestion supplies repetitive consumption; the doubled occurrence makes appetite a governing behavior rather than a single act.
Settled residence supplies the endpoint of a consumption path; transient enjoyment hardens into habitat.
An explicitly presented example supplies a worked sensorial model; it lets material provision elaborate the focus's example-making.
Aimless play supplies action without a sound end; it identifies one way appetite can follow what has no lasting hold.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies diverted attention; it explains how the unstable object captures a follower.

structural_cues: 47:12 places the two focus groups in parallel habitats, and 47:15 names the garden description an example; branchless ء س ن at 47:15:11 marks the water as non-stagnant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed habitats, consumption, an explicit garden-example, play, and distraction; I infer that these materialize the appetites trained by each orientation. A live alternative is that they are only downstream rewards and punishments, not mechanisms of following.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood and truth are rival informational objects.
changed_reading.after: They organize rival appetites and habitats: one sustains ordered flow, while the other loops through consumption and diversion into a fixed end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Decorated evil and inward inclination redirect following, while listening without uptake and a stamped heart show the chosen path becoming an interior mold. Falsehood is no longer only an external object; desire beautifies it, follows it, and becomes less able to receive correction.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an occluding operation; the context turns it into a process by which reception and interior visibility are progressively blocked.
Displaying something as beautiful supplies perceptual attraction; it makes harmful action look like a worthy lead.
Going after a lead supplies the same focus operation; here its proximate leader is inward inclination.
The soul's inclination supplies an internal vector; it bends following before any explicit doctrine is named.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the uptake that is missing; bare audition fails to interrupt the loop.
Sealing and impressing with a stamp supply durable interior form; repeated orientation becomes harder to revise.
The heart supplies the interior center being impressed; it locates falseward following within perception and volition.
Uninterrupted succession supplies repetition; the second desire-following scene confirms a maintained pattern.

structural_cues: 47:14 and 47:16 repeat the exact following-desires construction, with beautification before the first and failed listening plus heart-sealing before the second.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attraction, repeated desire-following, failed uptake, and sealing; I infer a feedback arrow from chosen inclination to reduced corrigibility. A live alternative is a one-way judicial sequence in which sealing follows but does not reinforce desire.

changed_reading.before: Unbelievers consciously choose an external false teaching.
changed_reading.after: Falseward following can be a self-reinforcing perceptual loop in which desire beautifies the lead and repeated uptake stamps the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away unfolds as severed kinship, closed sensory channels, locked hearts, and bodily retreat on the back after guidance had become clear. Following falsehood is thus a reversal that disconnects social and perceptual pathways needed for forward following.

activation_trace.role: Forward trailing supplies the directional baseline; later turning and backing expose its reversible opposite.
Turning the back and withdrawing supply directional reversal; they invert the focus's act of going after a lead.
Breaking connection and estranging supply social disjunction; reversal propagates into severed relations.
Kinship supplies the living bond being cut; it makes misorientation socially destructive rather than private.
Blocking a gap until no opening remains supplies sensory closure; it removes an incoming route for correction.
Blindness of insight supplies failed orientation; without inner sight, the follower cannot reassess the lead.
Closure hardened into a lock supplies durable blockage; it consolidates the sensory failures at the heart.
Apostatic reversal supplies explicit backward movement after prior alignment; it makes following a direction that can be abandoned.
The back or rear supplies the bodily face of retreat; it spatializes reversal after truth became visible.
Guidance to the road supplies the abandoned forward route; its prior clarity makes the retreat a changed direction, not mere ignorance.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence runs from turn-away to severed kinship, deafness and blindness, heart locks, and finally retreat on backs after guidance became clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily reversal and a chain of broken social and perceptual links; I infer that these links are the channels by which following stays correctable. A live alternative is that the sequence merely catalogs separate punishments and sins.

changed_reading.before: Following falsehood means advancing behind the wrong guide.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean reversing after clarity and progressively cutting the relational and perceptual channels that could turn one forward again.

context_deltas.mechanism: A decisive command creates pressure; latent sickness appears in a deathlike look, resolve tests verbal truth, hidden rancor is brought out, and marks, vocal inflection, deeds, and reports make orientation recognizable. Divine example-making becomes an assay that externalizes an otherwise hidden following-pattern.

activation_trace.role: Making a pattern evident supplies disclosure; the later trial sequence shows one way the divine exposition can occur.
A represented image supplies the legible output; pressure converts interior allegiance into such an image.
A tightly determined and decisive formulation supplies the stressor; ambiguity closes and latent response is forced toward expression.
Weakening and impaired movement supply a latent incapacity; the decisive demand makes it behaviorally visible.
A covering that overwhelms awareness supplies the observable deathlike look; inward disorder reaches the face.
A matter becoming firmly resolved supplies the decision threshold; speech must now become action or be exposed.
Fulfilling speech in action supplies the test criterion; enacted follow-through distinguishes truth from verbal posture.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies exteriorization; hidden antagonism becomes available to observation.
Causing something to be seen supplies controlled disclosure; the latent group can be rendered as an inspectable example.
Recognition through a trace or sign supplies inference from evidence; repeated recognition turns disclosure into a readable pattern.
A visible mark indicating condition supplies one diagnostic channel; inner following registers on outward appearance.
An inflection that bends speech toward its implication supplies a second diagnostic channel; allegiance leaks through wording and tone.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the assay itself; its doubled occurrence frames both persons and their reports as test material.
Knowledge of report and inward reality supplies the assay's target; declared news is tested against what lies beneath it.

structural_cues: Branchless ض غ ن at 47:29:11 names the concealed hostility brought out; the sequence then moves through visible mark, speech inflection, deeds, and tested reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, symptoms, exteriorization, diagnostic signs, and explicit testing; I infer that these are causal stages by which God renders the focus groups' likenesses legible. A live alternative is that the passages only announce divine knowledge and incidental recognition without an assay mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God states illustrative descriptions of believers and unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: God stages conditions that activate latent allegiance and produce a multimodal public readout in face, speech, action, and report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning addressed to believers not to invalidate their works turns falsehood from a fixed out-group possession into an operation that can act upon deeds inside believer-address. The focus binary remains real, but it also maps live practices and risks rather than immutable social essences.

activation_trace.role: Causing cancellation or removal supplies a transitive operation; later context applies that operation to works under believer-address.
Collapse and downward loss supply failed efficacy; hostile action terminates in works falling away rather than harming God.
Purposive deeds supply what can lose efficacy; the result remains anchored in enacted orientation.
Believing assent supplies the explicitly addressed identity; the warning therefore occurs inside, not outside, that category.
Repeated obedience supplies the positive operational demand; identity must continue into responsive practice.
Actively voiding something supplies the prohibited operation; it makes falsehood's cancellation capacity a live believer risk.
The addressees' deeds supply the vulnerable object; practical continuity, not a label alone, preserves their truthward course.

structural_cues: The vocative to believers in 47:33 immediately precedes repeated obedience commands and the transitive prohibition against making their own works void.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies believer-address plus a prohibition against active invalidation; I infer that the focus categories also name operations a person can enact or resist. A live alternative is that the warning is purely preventive and never implies actual crossing between the two patterns.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood belongs to one fixed group and truth to another fixed group.
changed_reading.after: The groups instantiate opposed patterns, but voiding and obedience remain live operations within the addressed believer's ongoing trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's claim-and-liability branches become an explicit moral ledger: deeds will not be diminished, work receives recompense, expenditure goes out, and withholding turns back upon the self. Truth is a binding right whose account is preserved; falsehood is cancellation that ultimately debits its follower.

activation_trace.role: A consequence or liability that adheres supplies the ledger's attachment rule; deeds remain connected to the one who follows.
An owned, enforceable right supplies the account's normative object; truth includes what is due to its holder.
A loss that deprives one of a right or work supplies prohibited diminution; the promise preserves the follower's account.
Purposive deeds supply the credited substance that will not be reduced.
Recompense for labor supplies the ledger's return; truthward action has preserved payable value.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies an apparent debit; the context revalues it as participation rather than loss.
The self as the very entity concerned supplies the account holder; withholding ultimately acts against that self.

structural_cues: The closing sequence repeats works, recompense, money, spending, withholding, self, wealth, and need, concentrating economic grammar around preserved or lost efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-diminution, recompense, expenditure, and self-directed withholding; I infer a conserved moral account attached to following. A live alternative is that these are separate encouragements and do not activate the focus's right-and-liability branches as one ledger.

changed_reading.before: Truth is correct content and falsehood is incorrect content.
changed_reading.after: Truth also behaves as a binding, preserved claim, while falsehood voids value and returns its apparent gains as liability upon the follower.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final warning joins turning away to substitution by another people who will not be the addressees' likenesses. This makes the focus's 'their likenesses' socially concrete: alignments form comparable cohorts, but the pattern is neither hereditary nor indispensable and can be replaced by a nonmatching one.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart or comparable likeness supplies the focus's human pattern; the closing warning tests whether another cohort will match it.
Turning away supplies the condition that breaks the current cohort's role.
One thing standing in another's place supplies actual replacement; no group has an irreplaceable claim to the truthward pattern.
A human collective supplies the unit that can instantiate a likeness; example becomes a social type, not only an individual portrait.
Changing one form for another supplies discontinuity; replacement can interrupt rather than reproduce the failed pattern.
Explicit non-likeness supplies the comparison test; it confirms that likeness can classify cohorts while leaving room for a changed successor.

structural_cues: The conditional turn-away at 47:38 is followed immediately by substitution and closes the surah on the same likeness root that closes the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional replacement and explicit non-likeness; I infer that the focus's examples include reproducible group-patterns whose carriers can change. A live alternative is that the final phrase only says the replacement people will behave better, without revising the focus's example construction.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes two already constituted groups for other people to contemplate.
changed_reading.after: It casts portable human types: cohorts can resemble a pattern, fail it, be replaced, and be succeeded by a deliberately nonmatching cohort.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the physical-impact and punitive-example branches resonate inside an idiom normally read as giving a parable. It remains anchored in the focus's adjacent striking and likeness roots and is activated by two later literal striking scenes. Downstream prose should present it only as a contextual undertone of consequences becoming exemplary, never as a claim that the focus verb itself simply means physical assault.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins the striking root at 47:3:15 to the plural likeness root at 47:3:18.

activation_trace.role: Impact of one thing upon another supplies physical force; beside the likeness root it permits a contained undertone of consequences that land.
Punitive marking that makes someone a deterrent example supplies penal exemplarity; it turns a suffered result into warning for others.
Literal striking in immediate post-focus context supplies the first material echo; it colors without replacing the focus idiom.
A second literal striking scene supplies a recurrent consequence motif at death, keeping bodily exemplarity contextually live.
A blow to the face supplies explicit bodily inscription; it sharpens the outlier's idea that hidden alignment can become a visible warning.

changed_reading.before: The closing phrase is purely verbal illustration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the illustration also carries a penal undertone: trajectories can culminate in consequences that make their carriers warning-examples.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the human-image-in-the-pupil branch of the people root and combines it with represented likeness and later recognition by marks. It remains anchored in 'for people, their likenesses' and in the focus's portrayal construction. Downstream prose should call it a reflexive visual analogy, not an etymological translation of 'people' or a claim that an eye is literally intended.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The audience root at 47:3:17 stands between divine portrayal and 'their likenesses' at 47:3:18.

activation_trace.role: The tiny human image seen in the eye's dark center supplies a literal mirror-image; it makes the audience potentially see itself in the examples.
Portraying an analogy supplies the act of presenting a view; it positions the likeness before the human observer.
A represented image supplies what is seen; it lets the two orientations function as reflected human portraits.
Causing hidden people to be seen supplies revelatory display; it activates the focus portrait as a recognition surface.
Recognition from traces supplies the observer's task; people can identify a pattern and potentially locate it in themselves.
A visible sign of condition supplies portrait detail; the likeness becomes diagnostic rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: People receive examples about two other groups.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, people are given a mirror of human orientation in which recognition of the depicted groups can become self-recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from disbelief's seed-covering branch and the Lord-root's split growth mapping into agricultural outcome language. It remains anchored in focus words for covering, lordly source, falsehood's uselessness, and later packet cues of harmful feeding, fruit, and increase. Downstream prose should retain it as a cultivation analogy only, not equate disbelief with farming or force every later food image into one code.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the covering root at 47:3:4, the useless or unproductive object at 47:3:6, and truth coming from the growth-capable split mapping of the Lord-root at 47:3:13.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies an agricultural act whose value depends on what follows; it opens a contained cultivation analogy for concealed potential.
Idleness and failure of useful work supply sterility; falseward covering yields no sound productive labor.
Feeding and growth supply cultivation from the non-dominant split root; truth from the Lord becomes growth under care.
Swelling from harmful grazing supplies deceptive intake that destroys rather than nourishes; it models false growth in works.
Ripe fruit supplies the visible yield of sound cultivation; it gives truthward formation a harvest image.
Increase and growth supply the tested result; prior guidance produces further growth rather than sterile covering.

changed_reading.before: Covering and following describe an epistemic choice between false and true content.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the choice resembles a cultivation assay: one covering produces deceptive swelling or sterility, while Lord-tended truth yields increase and fruit.

strongest_changes: The paired following verbs became causal trajectories whose orientation propagates into the efficacy, repair, or loss of deeds.
Divine example-making expanded from verbal comparison into historical evidence and trial-generated disclosure through face, speech, action, and report.
Following falsehood became an interior feedback loop of beautified desire, failed uptake, and durable imprinting, not only assent to an external error.
The believer/unbeliever contrast remained real but became operational and revisable: believers are warned that they can actively void their own works.
The likeness language became socially portable, classifying cohorts that can recur, fail, and be replaced by a deliberately nonmatching people.
summary.what_was_special: The same compact focus construction supported several nonexclusive mechanisms because later context repeatedly materialized its roots: following became gait, allegiance, appetite, and liability; striking and likeness became history, assay, image, warning, and cohort comparison. The packet's staged disclosure of latent states was especially activating and should not be collapsed into a single consensus gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between orientation and outcome may be immanent causation, divine judgment, or both; the packet does not force one arrow.
Later literal striking may add a penal undertone to the focus idiom, but it may also remain a deliberately separate sense of the root.
The likeness pronoun can sustain descriptions of the groups, outcomes like theirs, or comparable human types without requiring disambiguation.
The cultivation reading depends on a non-dominant split mapping and materially distant branches, so it should remain exploratory.
The focus categories can denote recognizable groups and live enacted operations at once; their exact degree of permeability remains unresolved.
